<style id="build14-overrides">
/* Navigation refinement: keep layout, enlarge logo and shift it slightly left */
.newNavIn{max-width:1290px!important}
.brand{flex:0 0 220px!important;margin-left:-10px!important}
.brand img{width:220px!important;height:66px!important;object-fit:contain!important}
.desktopShare,.desktopJoin{animation:navPop 3.8s ease-in-out infinite!important}
.desktopJoin{animation-delay:.35s!important}
@keyframes navPop{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.02)}}

/* Mature tool cards */
.matureToolGrid{gap:16px!important}
.matureTool{
  position:relative!important;
  min-height:168px!important;
  padding:20px 19px 18px!important;
  border-radius:17px!important;
  border:1px solid rgba(90,72,55,.15)!important;
  box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(57,39,25,.10)!important;
  overflow:hidden!important;
  display:flex!important;
  flex-direction:column!important;
  justify-content:flex-start!important;
}
.matureTool:nth-child(odd){background:#eee3d3!important;color:#342b25!important}
.matureTool:nth-child(even){background:#7e8e66!important;color:#fff!important}
.matureTool h3{
  font-size:19px!important;
  line-height:1.05!important;
  margin:0 0 12px!important;
  white-space:nowrap!important;
  letter-spacing:-.015em!important;
}
.matureTool p{
  font-size:13px!important;
  line-height:1.45!important;
  margin:0 0 16px!important;
  opacity:.94!important;
}
.matureTool .toolArrow{
  margin-top:auto!important;
  font:700 12px Georgia,serif!important;
  letter-spacing:.02em!important;
}
.matureTool:before{
  content:""!important;
  position:absolute!important;
  inset:-30% -70%!important;
  background:linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 42%,rgba(255,255,255,.34) 50%,transparent 58%)!important;
  transform:translateX(-55%)!important;
  opacity:0!important;
}
.matureTool:hover{
  transform:translateY(-4px)!important;
  box-shadow:0 16px 26px rgba(55,38,26,.22)!important;
}
.matureTool:hover:before{
  opacity:1!important;
  animation:cardShimmer .8s ease forwards!important;
}
@keyframes cardShimmer{to{transform:translateX(55%)}}

/* Compact horizontal planner ads: two across */
.stackedProducts{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  gap:20px!important;
}
.productRow{
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:150px minmax(0,1fr)!important;
  gap:17px!important;
  align-items:center!important;
  padding:16px!important;
  border-radius:20px!important;
  min-height:184px!important;
}
.productVideoWrap{
  width:150px!important;height:150px!important;
  aspect-ratio:1/1!important;
  margin:0!important;border-radius:16px!important;
}
.productVideoWrap video{width:150px!important;height:150px!important;object-fit:cover!important}
.productText{padding:0!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;min-width:0!important}
.productText h3{font-size:22px!important;line-height:1.05!important;margin:0 0 7px!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
.productEyebrow{order:2!important;font-size:10.5px!important;margin:0 0 8px!important}
.productText h3{order:1!important}
.productText p{order:3!important;font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.45!important;margin:0 0 10px!important}
.productText .btn,.productText a.btn{order:4!important;align-self:flex-start!important;margin-top:auto!important;font-size:12px!important;padding:8px 12px!important}

/* Align services */
.serviceAligned>.service{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;min-height:320px!important}
.serviceAligned .service h3{min-height:48px!important}
.serviceAligned .service p{min-height:72px!important}
.serviceAligned .service .btn{margin-top:auto!important;align-self:flex-start!important}

/* Market cards: align buttons */
.gardenShop .slide{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important}
.gardenShop .slide .pad{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;flex:1!important}
.gardenShop .slide .btn,.gardenShop .slide button{margin-top:auto!important;align-self:flex-start!important}

/* Course levels */
.courseLevelGrid{align-items:stretch!important}
.courseLevelCard{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;min-height:100%!important}
.courseLevelCard ul{padding-left:18px;margin:6px 0 18px;line-height:1.5;color:#5f554d}
.courseLevelCard .btn{margin-top:auto!important;align-self:flex-start!important}
.courseLevel{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;font-weight:900;color:#778567;margin-bottom:8px}
.courseAudience{font-weight:700;color:#64594f;margin-bottom:10px}

/* Free resource section */
.freeResourceSection{background:linear-gradient(#edf0e9,#f7f1e7)!important}
.freeResourceGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr;gap:30px;align-items:center}
.freeResourceMiniForm{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin:18px 0 8px}
.freeResourceMiniForm .btn{grid-column:1/-1;justify-self:start}
.freeResourceVisuals{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.freeResourceShot{background:#fff;border:1px solid #ddd2c4;border-radius:18px;padding:10px;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(57,39,25,.10)}
.freeResourceShot img{width:100%;height:260px;object-fit:contain;background:#faf8f4;border-radius:12px}
.freeResourceShot span{display:block;font:700 14px Georgia,serif;margin:9px 4px 2px}

/* Contact dropdown */
.contact form{padding:28px!important}
.contactMeta{margin-top:18px}

/* Social icons: no white circles/background */
.brandSocials a{background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;border:0!important;width:34px!important;height:34px!important}

/* Footer legal pages */
.footerLegal a{cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}
.footerLegal a:hover{text-decoration:underline}

/* Legal modal readability */
.legalCopy{max-width:780px}
.legalCopy h3{margin-top:22px}
.legalCopy ul{line-height:1.55}
.legalNote{background:#f6f0e7;border:1px solid #e0d5c5;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;color:#5c5148}

@media(max-width:1120px){
  .matureTool h3{font-size:17px!important}

}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .matureTool h3{white-space:normal!important}
  .freeResourceMiniForm,.freeResourceVisuals{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
  .freeResourceShot img{height:220px!important}
  .productRow{grid-template-columns:110px minmax(0,1fr)!important}
  .productVideoWrap,.productVideoWrap video{width:110px!important;height:110px!important}
}
</style>
<style id="build15-overrides">
/* Header/logo refinement */
.newNavIn{max-width:1292px!important;padding:8px 18px!important}
.brand{flex:0 0 248px!important;margin-left:-16px!important}
.brand img{width:248px!important;height:84px!important;object-fit:contain!important}
.navlinks a{font-size:13.6px!important}
.desktopShare,.desktopJoin{transition:transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease}
.desktopShare:hover,.desktopJoin:hover{transform:translateY(-1px) scale(1.03)}

/* Tool cards: mature cream style */
.creamToolGrid{gap:16px!important}
.creamTool{background:#fbf5ea!important;border:1px solid #dfd4c3!important;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(67,49,35,.10)!important;min-height:154px!important;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .22s ease, box-shadow .22s ease}
.creamTool:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)!important;box-shadow:0 18px 28px rgba(59,39,26,.18)!important}
.creamTool .toolTitleRow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px}
.creamTool .toolMiniIcon{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:#ede0cf;color:#5a4334;font:700 16px Georgia,serif;flex:0 0 28px}
.creamTool h3{margin:0!important;font-size:18px!important;line-height:1!important;white-space:nowrap!important;color:#35271f!important;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.creamTool p{font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.45!important;margin:0;color:#66584e!important}

/* Planner stack */
.plannerStack{display:grid;gap:22px}
.plannerCard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:340px minmax(0,1fr);overflow:hidden;border-radius:22px;background:#fffdf9;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(59,39,26,.11)}
.plannerMedia{background:#f4ede2;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:18px}
.plannerMedia video{width:100%!important;max-width:300px!important;height:300px!important;object-fit:cover!important;border-radius:18px!important}
.plannerCopy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.plannerCopy h3{font-size:32px!important;line-height:1!important;margin:5px 0 10px!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
.plannerCopy p{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.58!important;margin:0 0 14px!important}
.plannerActions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}

/* Tool preview sections */
.toolDetail{padding:52px 0!important}
.toolDetailGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:center}
.toolDetailGrid.reverse .toolDetailImg{order:2}.toolDetailGrid.reverse .toolDetailCopy{order:1}
.toolDetailImg img{width:100%;height:340px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(56,38,25,.16)}
.toolDetailCopy ul{padding-left:20px;line-height:1.6;color:#5d5148;margin:14px 0 20px}
.toolAltA{background:#f6efe4!important}.toolAltB{background:#eef1e8!important}.toolAltC{background:#fffdf9!important}.toolAltD{background:#f0e6da!important}
.ghostBtn{pointer-events:none;opacity:.92}

/* Blog grid */
.blogGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px}
.blogCard{overflow:hidden;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(58,39,26,.10)!important}
.blogCard img{width:100%;height:220px;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.blogCard h3{font-size:22px;line-height:1.08;margin:6px 0 8px}
.blogCard p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:#5d5249;min-height:84px}

/* Share menu visuals */
.shareMenu{background:rgba(255,251,246,.98)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.shareMenu button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px!important}
.smIcon{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:25px;height:25px;border-radius:999px;color:#fff;font:700 13px/1 Arial,sans-serif;flex:0 0 25px}
.smIcon.fb{background:#1877F2}.smIcon.pin{background:#E60023}.smIcon.mail{background:#6a8f58}.smIcon.copy{background:#8a6c54}

/* Join modal + freebie popup tone */
.modal{background:rgba(39,28,21,.24)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
.modalBox{background:rgba(253,248,241,.97)!important;border:1px solid rgba(139,113,86,.18)!important;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(40,28,20,.16)!important}
.freebieBox{max-width:880px!important}
.freebieFine{color:#6c6158!important}
.joinFriendly .joinGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
.joinFriendly .joinWide{grid-column:1/-1}
.joinFriendly .joinNote{background:#f6efe3;border:1px solid #e1d6c6;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px;color:#5c4d40;margin:12px 0 16px}

/* resource section still visible */
.freeResourceSection .btn{box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(57,39,25,.12)}

/* Responsive */
@media(max-width:1100px){
  .blogGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media(max-width:980px){
  .toolDetailGrid,.plannerCard{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
  .toolDetailGrid.reverse .toolDetailImg,.toolDetailGrid.reverse .toolDetailCopy{order:initial}
  .plannerMedia video{max-width:280px!important;height:280px!important}
}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .brand{flex-basis:auto!important;margin-left:0!important}
  .brand img{width:198px!important;height:70px!important}
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .creamTool h3{font-size:16px!important;white-space:normal!important}
  .toolDetailImg img{height:260px!important}
  .blogGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .plannerMedia video{max-width:240px!important;height:240px!important}
  .joinFriendly .joinGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>
<style id="build16-overrides">
/* tool cards cleaner + lighter */
.creamTool{background:#fffdfa!important;border:1px solid #e4d9c9!important;box-shadow:0 14px 24px rgba(67,49,35,.10)!important}
.creamTool .toolMiniIcon{background:none!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important;min-width:0!important;border-radius:0!important;padding:0!important;display:inline-block!important;color:#5b4636!important;font-size:18px!important;line-height:1!important}
.creamTool .toolTitleRow{gap:8px!important}

/* free resources distinct divider */
.giftDividerSection{position:relative!important;border-top:2px solid #dbcdb8!important;border-bottom:2px solid #dbcdb8!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f4eee3 0%,#fcfaf6 100%)!important}
.giftDividerSection:before,.giftDividerSection:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;height:1px;background:rgba(103,79,58,.18)}
.giftDividerSection:before{top:8px}.giftDividerSection:after{bottom:8px}

/* services and shop richer cards */
.servicesRichGrid,.enhancedCourses{align-items:stretch}
.serviceRichCard,.richSlide{overflow:hidden;border-radius:22px;background:#fffdf9;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(57,39,26,.11)!important}
.serviceRichCard img,.richSlide img{width:100%;height:210px;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.serviceRichCopy h3,.richSlide h3{margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:24px!important}
.serviceRichCopy p,.richSlide p{color:#5f554d;line-height:1.55;min-height:92px}
.richRail{gap:18px!important}
.richRail .slide{min-width:340px!important;max-width:340px!important}

/* courses */
.courseVisualCard{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.courseStrip{height:92px;border-radius:16px;margin:8px 0 14px;background-size:cover;background-position:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}
.courseStrip:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.10),rgba(0,0,0,.45))}
.courseStrip span{position:relative;z-index:1;color:#fff;font-weight:700;padding:10px 12px;display:block}
.courseVisualCard p{line-height:1.55;color:#5f554d}
.courseVisualCard ul{padding-left:18px;line-height:1.58;display:grid;gap:6px}
.courseVisualCard .btn{margin-top:auto}

/* blog carousel */
.blogRailWrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:14px;align-items:center}
.blogRail{display:flex;gap:20px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding:4px 2px 12px}
.blogRail::-webkit-scrollbar{height:10px}.blogRail::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#cfbfaa;border-radius:999px}
.blogSlideCard{flex:0 0 calc((100% - 40px)/3);scroll-snap-align:start;overflow:hidden;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(58,39,26,.10)!important}
.blogSlideCard img{width:100%;height:220px;object-fit:cover;display:block}
